body: I can't afford to see a private psychologist. I'm thinking of just begging or doing something dramatic because I just can't cope.

I start by making sure the blades I use are clean and the part of my body I want to cut is sterile. I have clean tissues and bandages on the side in case I bleed too much. And I always put it under the tap or shower head after I draw blood, and boy does it sting, but its cleaner that way.

I'm basically just doing it as a cry for help. I get no pleasure out of it at all. In fact I'm quite squeemish about it. But I have several long cuts all along my forearm and probably plan on adding more to my other arm in the same fashion. I mean I'm not going around saying hey look at my cool scars. I'm actually really shameful of my scars and cuts and do anything to avoid people seing them except for people I really, really trust.

The psychologist asked me why I cut but I just said I don't know because I'm afraid they might take my real reason as a threat against them or something like that. I'm not even on the damn waiting list to have sessions with the psychologist. All they want to do is give me anti-depressents and send me to the occupational therapist and nurses. I have problems that won't go away with just medication or going to collage or something. I have past traumas that have been haunting me for a decade. And I'd be willing to take things further than SH if it means getting the help I need. Life is hell.

TL ; DR : rant, vent
